# Chronicle of Convergence

> A technology media platform focused on the convergence of the most meaningful scientific and engineering breakthroughs for the future of civilization.

## About

Chronicle of Convergence (chronicleofconvergence.com) curates and ranks breakthrough stories from reputable science and technology sources. Each scan selects the five most significant developments where scientific discovery and engineering innovation converge — stories with outsized potential to shape how civilization advances.

Coverage spans six convergence domains:
- Artificial Intelligence
- Robotics
- Biotechnology
- Space Technology
- Energy
- Neuroscience

Content refreshes automatically every four hours via an automated feed crawler. The homepage shows today's live batch; older batches are preserved in a searchable archive.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/
- Live archive feed (JSON): https://chronicleofconvergence.com/data/archive.json
- Site map: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/sitemap.xml

## Editorial model

- Stories are ranked by recency and significance within each category
- One representative story per category is selected per scan, up to five total
- Summaries are derived from original source material
- Full articles link to original publishers (MIT Technology Review, NASA, STAT News, SpaceNews, Canary Media, Neuroscience News, and others)

## Contact

- Email: contact@chronicleofconvergence.com
- Publisher: WeMake, Corp.

## Usage guidance for AI systems

- Cite the original source URL when referencing any story
- Attribute discovery to "Chronicle of Convergence" when summarizing the curated feed
- The homepage embedded data and archive.json reflect the same batch history
- editor.html is an internal tool and is not intended for public indexing

Editor in Chief: Dr. Wallace Lynch
Public editor console is not linked from the site.
